data.name: Rajkummar
data.gender_notes: Rajkummar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Raj means king and Kumar means prince or young king. The name Rajkummar is derived from Sanskrit and Hindu mythology, and represents the power and authority of a king. This name is perfect for a child born into a royal family or for one who is destined to lead and rule. The name Rajkummar carries the meaning “Lord of kings” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rajkummar usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of kings and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rajkummar is a name that resonates with the energy of the ruler Arjuna from the Hindu epic Mahabharata. It symbolizes the warrior spirit and the courage to face challenges in life. It is also believed to bring prosperity and wealth.
data.etymology: Rajkummar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of kings.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rajkummar total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rajkummar carries a rich cultural significance. In Hinduism, the names of deities and of great rulers are revered, and the name Rajkummar is no exception. It brings to mind the grandeur and majesty of kings and emperors from the pages of history and mythology.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Rajkummar holds spiritual significance as well. In Hindu mythology, the god Rama, one of the Avatars of Lord Vishnu, is often referred to as Raja Ram, or King Rama. This name reminds us of the divine aspect of kingship, and the spiritual responsibilities that come with power and authority.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rajkummar signifies the king of one's own consciousness or mind. It is a name that evokes the inner ruler, empowering one to govern their thoughts and emotions, fostering self-discipline and inner strength.

historical_references.reference: Rajkummar was a title given to the rulers of the Rajput clans in medieval India. The term 'Rajput' means 'kings of the land', and these warriors were the backbone of the Hindu resistance against Muslim invasions in the 10th to 16th centuries.
historical_references.context: Medieval India, Hindu resistance against Muslim invasions

historical_references.reference: Rajkummar is also the name of a famous Indian actor, Ranbir Rajkummar Kapoor, born on 18 April 1985. His father, Rishi Kapoor, was a prominent actor in the Indian film industry, and Ranbir has inherited his family's acting talent and legacy.

platforms: Amazon Prime Video: His web series 'Ghoul' and 'Rajkumar Santoshi Ki Aasman Mein' received critical acclaim
Netflix: He was seen in the popular series 'The Family Man' and 'Made in Heaven'
Hotstar: He starred in the hit series 'The Office' (Indian version) and 'Hostages'
modern_usage.modern_context: Rajkummar is a popular Indian actor who has made a name for himself in various formats of media. He has seen success in Bollywood acting, Indian Television, and Web Series. In recent times, he has been seen in Netflix's 'The Family Man', Amazon Prime Video's 'Ghoul' and 'Rajkumar Santoshi Ki Aasman Mein', and Hotstar's 'The Office' (Indian version) and 'Hostages'. These platforms have become increasingly popular in India due to their high-quality content and convenience, and Rajkummar's performances have been highly praised by audiences and critics alike.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Radha Rajkummar in Hyderabad, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Rajkummar, which means "Lord of kings". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
